svg.title: Cartan reconstruction and an intrinsic symmetry
svg.desc: A Cartan-preserving action covering a point map is forced by the transformed-graph recurrence. Holonomic planes recover the next jet. The intrinsic action x prime equals x plus s, u prime equals u plus s p, p prime equals p preserves the equation u xx equals zero but fails to descend to the original point space.
